status: six-card faction expansion prototypes under design and balance review

cards.name: High Command
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked High Command.

open_questions: Determine whether maximum-one-banked is sufficient or Unique is warranted.
Test General and Commandant Order chains at a 3-Command ceiling.

cards.name: Plenipotentiary
cards.design_status: accepted prototype direction; Influence curve remains a balance test

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the opponent refuses an unratified Proposal, you may put this card in your Graveyard and spend Influence equal to the number of Proposals you would then have ratified. If you do, ratify that Proposal. Gain no Influence for ratifying it this way. Its Refused effect still applies.

effects.label: Gambit
effects.text: If this battle follows refused Terms, apply the Refused effect of one other ratified Proposal whose requirement is met.

open_questions: Test whether the 1/2/3/4/5 Influence curve is steep enough, especially as a fifth-Article finisher.
If needed, compare a mildly steeper 1/2/3/5/7 curve.
Audit every Proposal requirement and Refused effect against the Gambit mode.

cards.name: War Bonds
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked War Bonds.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the first battle each turn, you may place one card from your Hand face up in your Treasury. If you do, +1 Capital.

open_questions: Test defensive-battle triggers and Treasury growth rate.
Audit Financial Capacity and Executive action-economy interactions.

cards.name: Regime Change
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and uniqueness/restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked Regime Change.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The opponent cannot use their Leader abilities.

rules_intent: Military Leader Orders count as Leader abilities.
The opponent retains their faction engine; only Leader-specific abilities are suppressed.
Regime Change does not remove, replace, or discard the Leader Card.
open_questions: Audit every current Leader and Military Order.
Confirm cost and whether the card should be Unique.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked copy.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The first time each turn you put an Arcane card from your Hand in your Graveyard as a cost or effect you control, after that effect resolves, you may return one other lower-value card from your Graveyard to your Hand.

open_questions: Confirm whether the card itself has the Arcane trait.
Test recursion loops and whether recovery should remain unrestricted by allegiance or trait.
Confirm the first-time-each-turn and post-resolution timing.

cards.name: Retribution
cards.design_status: accepted leading direction; punishment tuning provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the opponent loses a battle they initiated, you may discard this card. If you do, they choose one: put one of their Assets in their Graveyard; or +2 Conviction. If they have no Assets, +2 Conviction.

open_questions: Confirm whether 2 Conviction is the correct alternative to losing an Asset.
Test Graveyard versus Discard as the Asset destination.
Test interaction with Asset protection such as Decoys.
